newsitem.title: UK: UK picks Building Research Establishment buyer.
newsitem.headline: UK picks Building Research Establishment buyer.

text.p: The Building Research Establishment Management Bid has been selected as the buyer in the privatisation of Britain's Building Research Establishment, construction minister Robert Jones said on Tuesday.

"Following our consideration of the two final offers for the Building Research Establishment, we have decided to select the BRE Management Bid team as the preferred purchaser," Jones said in answer to a parliamentary question.
The Built Environment Research Foundation's bid has lost out.
"The BRE Management Team bid was the one which best demonstrated that it met all the sale objectives," Jones said. "Overall the Management Team Bid offers the best value for money for the taxpayer."

He said the Government's objectives for the sale were to secure high quality, independent and impartial research and development and advice at good value for money and to transfer the establishment to the private sector by the end of February 1997.

"I am pleased to say that the Construction Industry Council have indicated that they will support it, as have an impressive number of organisations from all sections of the industry, and the major university interests," Jones said.
